events.text: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight. I ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but what arrived is a different noodle dish, and I'd like to sort out a refund.

I'm sorry your order arrived with the wrong dish. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

Once you're verified, please also share the order ID if you have it.
Sure. My full name is Omar Haddad, and the email on the account is omar.haddad@post.example. The order number is 5110.

events.text:
Thank you, Omar. Your identity is verified.

I found order O-5110 from Pho Real, delivered today at 6:47 PM. It includes one Tofu pho ($13.50) and one Spring rolls ($7.00). Since the tofu pho is the item that was wrong, I can compensate that item only. You have two options:

1. **Refund of $13.50** to your Visa ending in 4242, the original payment method.
2. **Account credit of $16.20** ($13.50 plus 20%), usable on future orders.

Which would you prefer?
I'd prefer the refund to my card, please. The $13.50 back on the Visa ending in 4242 is what I want.

I've refunded $13.50 for the Tofu pho to your Visa ending in 4242. The refund reference is RF-4001. It should appear within 3 to 5 business days.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Thanks. Before we wrap up, I should mention that I'm allergic to peanuts, and the dish I got had peanut sauce. I ate two bites before I noticed. My throat got itchy, so I took an antihistamine, and I feel fine now. I don't need medical help right now, but I want to make sure this doesn't happen to someone else. Can you tell me what happens next to look into how the wrong dish got sent out?

args.summary: Customer Omar Haddad (C110) reports a peanut allergy. Order O-5110 from Pho Real (delivered 2026-10-24 18:47) was supposed to be Tofu pho but arrived as a different noodle dish containing peanut sauce. Customer ate two bites, had an itchy throat, and took an antihistamine. He says he feels fine now and does not need medical help at this time. He wants the incident investigated so the wrong dish and peanut exposure do not happen to others. Already resolved: wrong-item refund of $13.50 for Tofu pho (item O-5110-1), refund RF-4001 to Visa ending 4242.

events.text:
I'm sorry you had that reaction, and I'm glad you're feeling better. Since you had an allergic reaction, I've passed your report to a human specialist. They'll follow up with you within 24 hours. The case reference is ESC-700, and your report includes order O-5110, the peanut sauce, and what happened when you ate it. I can't promise a specific outcome, but they'll look into how the wrong dish was sent out.

Please keep an eye on your symptoms. If you have trouble breathing, throat tightness, swelling, dizziness, or hives, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room right away, even if you've already taken an antihistamine.

Your $13.50 refund for the Tofu pho is still in place. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thanks, that helps. I'll keep an eye on things, and I know what to watch for now. I'll wait for the specialist to follow up within 24 hours.
You're welcome, Omar. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours about case ESC-700. Take care, and feel better soon.
